title: We're newlyweds, but I can't have sex with her, the team captain
description: Yuto is an ordinary young man who just so happens to be married to Asuka Amou, one of Japan's brightest stars in women's volleyball. To the public, Asuka is the cool, dependable captain with an outstanding career. But behind closed doors, she's nothing like her flawless image. Around Yuto, she turns into an incredibly clingy, hopelessly spoiled wife—so adorable that her fans would faint if they ever saw her like this! On top of that, the stress of being an elite athlete has left her with a very high sex drive, making it hard for her to resist getting intimate with her beloved husband. The problem? A major tournament is just around the corner, and getting pregnant now could derail her career and affect the entire team. Determined to support her dreams, Yuto insists they hold off on sex for the time being. Can Asuka really keep her desires in check when the temptation is right beside her? And can Yuto handle the irresistible charms of his affectionate wife without giving in?
author: Nyoi Jizai
